page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of the opening, the right-hand page is cut off at the edge and shows only marginal fragments). Running head at top left and page number at top centre. Main text in one column with braces (diagram-like brackets) that group phrases; marginal text at the right edge of the scan is cut off and not legible enough to transcribe.

main_text.p: erat, vt vestes propriæ ijs imponerentur. Leui.8. 13. Sunt autem Tiaræ ad gloriam. Exo.28.40.
Leuitæ sunt reliqui Leuitæ, ad ministerium sacrũ, loco omnium primogenitorum Israelis assumpti. Num.18.6.& 3.9.10.11.12.& 8.14 15.16.
Quod quia superabant primogeniti Israelitarum circiter ducentos septuaginta tres: ad ipsos redimendos, pro quoq; capite quinos siclos sacros accepit, & Aharoni & filijs eius dedit. Num.3.48.49.
Horum muneris partes erant {Tabernaculo erecto ipsi seruire. Cum deportandum erat illud deportare.} Num. 4.3.
In deportando, officium erat diuersis familijs distributum. Num.4.

{Primò erat vt à sacerdotibus velo depositò sanctuarij, & à suo tegumento cum instrumentis tecto: illud cum suis omnibus instrumentis & adiunctis ordine præscripto collocatis portarent. Num.4.5.6.ad 15. Koathitæ.} Quare {Secundo eis in præfectu Ithamare constituto} deportabat. {Gershonitæ tabernaculi aulæa, tentoriũ couctus, cum instrumetis itè atrij portæ tegmentũ cũ suis adiunctis. Nu.4 25.28. Meraritæ, reliquæ. Num.4 29.32.}

page.notes: Right-hand page cut off; marginal notes on the right edge are illegible. Braced passages rendered as running text; several words in the braces are approximate. Catchword "Atq" at lower right is uncertain.
